description: This file defines the template class `absl::AnyInvocable`, a type-erased, move-only functional wrapper similar to `std::function`, supporting various invocable objects with specific function signatures and qualifiers. It provides type safety, const correctness, and reference qualifiers, and is used for accepting flexible functional parameters in the Abseil library.

classes.name: absl::AnyInvocable
classes.description: A move-only, type-erased wrapper for invocable objects with a specified function signature, supporting const, reference, and noexcept qualifiers.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the stored invocable object with the specified signature.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two `AnyInvocable` instances.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the `AnyInvocable` contains a callable target.
